_comment: Supplemental sources for public/data/malicious-packages.json. This file does not replace the SSOT; scripts/build_malicious_package_index.py can use it to enrich the SSOT from advisory feeds that are not covered completely by the Datadog sample tree.

tanstack_may_2026.name: TanStack May 2026 npm supply-chain compromise
tanstack_may_2026.notes: OSV/GHSA is preferred for affected TanStack package names and exact malicious versions. The TanStack postmortem is preferred for incident context and clean-package clarifications.

external_advisory_supplement.name: External advisory supplemental package source
external_advisory_supplement.notes: Used for advisories that are not represented completely by the Datadog sample tree. Entries should keep exact package names and versions from machine-readable advisory feeds when available.

osv_advisories.notes: TanStack router/start package compromise. Import exact affected packages and versions from OSV rather than copying KISA package names verbatim.

manual_review_aliases.reason: KISA-style list and Datadog/local SSOT differ; validate against JFrog/Datadog/npm before adding as a new package.
